11:110.text: Indeed, We gave the Book to Mûsâ

, but differences arose therein, and had it not been for a Word that had gone forth before from your Lord, the case would have been judged between them, and indeed they are in grave doubt concerning it

11:111.text: And verily, to each of them your Lord will repay their works in full. Surely, He is All-Aware of what they do.

11:113.text: And incline not toward those who do wrong, lest the Fire should touch you, and you have no protectors other than Allâh, nor you would then be helped.

11:115.text: And be patient; verily, Allâh wastes not the reward of the good-doers.

11:116.text: If only there had been among the generations before you persons having wisdom, prohibiting
(disbelief, polytheism, and all kinds of crimes and sins)

11:117.text: And your Lord would never destroy the towns wrongfully, while their people were right-doers.
